description: [Merchant] Update an existing price schedule. Only provide the fields you want to change: payware keeps every stored value the request leaves out. With neither dateFrom nor dateTo the schedule's period stays as stored; with one of them the other is worked out as on create (dateFrom alone: the period runs one month from it; dateTo alone: it starts one month before dateTo, or today if that is later), and a start before today is refused (ERR_INVALID_ACTIVE_FROM_DATE). Premium (PRM) plan only: the server answers 403 on any other plan (for an ISV, the merchant's plan).

correctionValue.description: Correction value (positive number with max 2 decimals)

partnerId.description: Merchant partner ID (uses PAYWARE_PARTNER_ID env var as default)

privateKey.description: RSA private key for authentication (uses environment-specific private key as default)

name: payware_products_update_schedule
